summary: The reviewed commit contains coherent RC4 evidence and does not change the production implementation validated at 3a62520, but it is not release-ready or durably recoverable. The local feature branch is two commits ahead of origin, no tag identifies RC4, the current audit has no completed gate decision, manifest pipeline/profile hashes do not match recoverable Git or working-tree bytes, and replay manifests reference unarchived absolute-path outputs.

evidence: `git rev-parse HEAD` returned `366fc22eb53df812dd3f162eb26cdbab46b66b61`.
`git status --short --branch` returned detached `## HEAD (no branch)` plus untracked `audits/runs/20260827-v571-remediation-acceptance-rc4/`.

audits/runs/20260827-v571-remediation-acceptance-rc4/manifest.json:5-7 records the reviewed commit, branch `DETACHED`, and `dirty_worktree: false`; the audit-generated run directory subsequently appears untracked.
`git diff --stat` and `git diff --cached --stat` reported no tracked modifications.
`git remote -v` identifies origin as `https://github.com/dushyant-mishra/Drosophila-sperm-nuclei-segmentation.git`.
`git branch -avv` reports local `feature/v5.7.1-annotation-tolerant-unet` at 366fc22 and `[origin/feature/v5.7.1-annotation-tolerant-unet: ahead 2]`; the origin-tracking ref is 5bb5a83.

`git log --oneline origin/feature/v5.7.1-annotation-tolerant-unet..feature/v5.7.1-annotation-tolerant-unet` lists unpushed commits `3a62520 Resolve v5.7.1 acceptance audit blockers` and `366fc22 Add v5.7.1 RC4 validation evidence`.
Live `git ls-remote` failed because github.com was inaccessible, so no evidence contradicts the local ahead-by-two state.
audits/validation/v571_3a62520_validation.md:3 identifies production-code commit 3a62520; lines 15-26 record compilation, 214 passing tests, tuner self-check, and `git diff --check`.

`git diff --quiet 3a62520..366fc22 -- sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py utils/tune_parameters_Saturnv5_7_1.py utils/saturn_unet25d_bridge.py production_profiles/saturn_v5_7_1_model_c_epoch003.json model_checkpoints/v571_model_c_dual_head_epoch003.pt tests` returned exit 0, confirming the evidence commit did not alter validated production inputs or tests.
Locally calculated SHA-256 values match audits/validation/v571_3a62520_validation.md:33-38 for all six archived evidence artifacts.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:4728 and utils/tune_parameters_Saturnv5_7_1.py:36 identify runtime version `v5.7.1-body-width`.

production_profiles/saturn_v5_7_1_model_c_epoch003.json:216 identifies `pipeline_version` as `v5.7.1-dual-head-width`, while audits/evidence/v571_rc4_candidate/report/02_quality_control/source_files/study_run_state.json:2 records `v5.7.1-body-width`.

production_profiles/saturn_v5_7_1_model_c_epoch003.json:32, V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:10-11, and audits/validation/v571_3a62520_validation.md:7 consistently identify checkpoint `v571_model_c_dual_head_epoch003.pt` with SHA-256 `7d49031dbcce31f0600c44146d9b5282b0df6e28bb1fc1bdde6ef2146ed15d25`.
Hashing the committed checkpoint with the required `.venv` interpreter reproduced `7d49031dbcce31f0600c44146d9b5282b0df6e28bb1fc1bdde6ef2146ed15d25`.

audits/evidence/v571_rc4_candidate/stages/visual_evidence_manifest.json:4 and audits/evidence/v571_rc4_candidate/tracking/tracking_replay_manifest.json:4 record pipeline SHA-256 `d3933b25d6a3bcebda93dd3c40f7aedf2c27bc4f61e0935d9258cef3bc8ead26`.

Hashing the reviewed working-tree pipeline with `.venv\Scripts\python.exe` produced `fbec09d726616163753e39d55e1760ff3275eba2976cd12ee255bb60792a5e71`; hashing bytes recovered through `git show HEAD:sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py` produced `4f32c3bccc47723c35ffff86753de0e2daf123d1f3c3368089ac64cd806044c4`. Neither matches the manifests.

The stage and tracking manifests record profile SHA-256 `3620551cd6df82a42aaa53ca234061bb699a9eb7cf43cb67c21371f0c1cc3c82`, but reviewed working-tree profile bytes hash to `ff81aa0c7d2af6938cbc4c5af5452a11f7503818105a92bb4ffd8c379bdf76fe` and Git-recovered bytes hash to `74c9c2519e086820ffae95762877935e0dd5b7539dc829afa49b27260e8c4bdc`.

audits/validation/v571_3a62520_validation.md:9-11 asserts the manifests bind production source by commit and pipeline SHA-256, but the recorded hashes cannot be reproduced from the reviewed repository state.
audits/runs/20260827-v571-remediation-acceptance-rc4/manifest.json:21-25 has `completed_at_utc: null` and an empty `role_exit_codes` object.
The current run directory contains no `gate_summary.json` or `decision.json`; directory inspection found only manifest, claim snapshot, prompts, reviews, and logs.
audits/claims_registry.json:61-64 still identifies the latest audit as `20260821-v571-production-diagnostic`, with `gate_passed: false` and `blocked_pending_remediation`.
audits/README.md:86-96 requires passing automated tests and audit validation before a production release.
`git tag --points-at HEAD` returned no tag for reviewed commit 366fc22.
`git cat-file -t` reports existing v5.7.0 and v5.7.1-rc1 through rc3 tags as annotated tag objects, but the newest candidate tag is v5.7.1-rc3 targeting 5bb5a83.

audits/evidence/v571_rc4_candidate/tracking/tracking_replay_manifest.json:12-17 and 22-27 reference source detections and replay CSVs through absolute `C:\Users\dmishra\Desktop\sperm_project\scratch\...` paths.

The referenced full tracked and track-summary CSVs are not among files tracked under audits/evidence/v571_rc4_candidate; only replay manifests, candidates, and the aggregate replay summary are committed.
`git status --ignored --short` records ignored `.venv/` and current-run `logs/`; no ignored research image stack was present in this checkout.
A case-insensitive scan of tracked paths for `.env`, private-key, credential, and secret filename patterns returned no matches.

Tracked files larger than 10 MB were limited to two documentation DOCX files; the RC4 commit scope shown by `git show --stat 366fc22` consists of claims, validation receipt, audit evidence, and the audit launcher change.
`git check-attr filter diff merge -- model_checkpoints/v571_model_c_dual_head_epoch003.pt` reports no Git LFS filters, while the checkpoint itself is tracked and its SHA-256 is reproducible.
V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:83 states the results describe one specimen per group and are not a genotype inference.
V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:99-101 states inferential statistics are unavailable until each group has at least three independent specimens.
V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:140-144 explicitly says an independent seven-role audit on a clean pushed commit is required before release tagging or a full biological rerun.

Command `.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q tests/test_saturn_v571_dual_head.py tests/test_saturn_v571_body_width.py` failed before collection with `FileNotFoundError: No usable temporary directory found`.
The failure reflects the managed read-only environment rather than a test failure; commit-bound receipt audits/validation/v571_3a62520_validation.md:19-20 records `214 passed in 21.00s`.
`git branch -avv` lists historical local branches including `audit-v571-post-remediation` at 8c1f9f5 and `feature/v5.7.1-body-width` at 1600a39 without upstreams.
No repository policy or merge/closure evidence was available to determine whether these branches are intentionally retained or stale; no deletion was attempted.

findings.title: Reviewed RC4 commits are not synchronized to origin
findings.impact: The production remediation and RC4 evidence cannot be recovered from the configured remote, so release publication and durable recovery requirements are unmet.
evidence: `git branch -avv` reports the feature branch ahead of origin by two commits.
`git log origin/feature/v5.7.1-annotation-tolerant-unet..feature/v5.7.1-annotation-tolerant-unet` lists 3a62520 and 366fc22.
V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:143 requires a clean pushed commit before release tagging.
findings.recommendation: After the audit gate passes and explicit authorization is obtained, push the reviewed branch and independently verify the remote ref resolves to 366fc22eb53df812dd3f162eb26cdbab46b66b61.

findings.title: Commit-bound source and profile hashes are not reproducible
findings.impact: A future reviewer cannot establish that the archived visual and tracking evidence was generated by the exact pipeline/profile recoverable from the reviewed Git commit.
evidence: Stage and tracking manifests record pipeline hash `d3933b...`, while reviewed working-tree and Git-recovered bytes produced `fbec09...` and `4f32c3...`.
Stage and tracking manifests record profile hash `362055...`, while reviewed working-tree and Git-recovered bytes produced `ff81aa...` and `74c9c2...`.
audits/validation/v571_3a62520_validation.md:9-11 claims this hash binding exists.
findings.recommendation: Determine and document the byte-canonicalization cause or regenerate the manifests from clean Git-recovered files. Archive a reproducible hash command and require its outputs to match the manifest before rerunning the audit.

findings.title: Current audit gate and release decision are incomplete
findings.impact: The high-risk claim remains blocked under the repository's own release rules, and this role cannot substitute for the missing independent reviews or decision.
evidence: Current manifest has no completion time or role exit codes at audits/runs/20260827-v571-remediation-acceptance-rc4/manifest.json:21-25.
No current `gate_summary.json` or `decision.json` exists.
audits/claims_registry.json:61-64 retains the prior failed diagnostic audit as latest.
findings.recommendation: Collect all required independent review JSON, run the documented audit validator against this exact commit, archive its gate summary, and create an append-only decision only if every required review passes.

findings.title: Full replay artifacts are referenced only through nonportable local paths
findings.impact: The replay cannot be independently reconstructed from repository evidence alone if the original desktop scratch directory is lost or changed.
evidence: audits/evidence/v571_rc4_candidate/tracking/tracking_replay_manifest.json:12-17 and 22-27 contain absolute desktop and scratch paths.
The referenced full source-detection, tracked-detection, and track-summary CSVs are not tracked under the RC4 evidence directory.
findings.recommendation: Archive the immutable replay inputs and outputs, or a content-addressed external archive receipt with availability verification, then replace or supplement local paths with portable archive identifiers.

findings.title: Version identifiers differ between production profile and runtime outputs
findings.impact: The release cannot unambiguously demonstrate that code, tuner, profile, and reports refer to one exact version label.
evidence: sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:4728 and utils/tune_parameters_Saturnv5_7_1.py:36 use `v5.7.1-body-width`.
production_profiles/saturn_v5_7_1_model_c_epoch003.json:216 uses `v5.7.1-dual-head-width`.
The archived study run state uses `v5.7.1-body-width`.
findings.recommendation: Adopt one canonical version identifier or explicitly document a schema distinguishing profile compatibility version from runtime pipeline version, with a validation test enforcing the mapping.

findings.title: No annotated tag identifies the reviewed RC4 commit
findings.impact: The candidate lacks a stable human-readable release reference, while the newest existing RC tag identifies the pre-remediation origin commit.
evidence: `git tag --points-at HEAD` returned no tag.
Annotated `v5.7.1-rc3` targets 5bb5a83; reviewed HEAD is 366fc22.
findings.recommendation: Only after the audit passes, the commit is pushed, and explicit authorization is obtained, create and push an annotated RC4 or final release tag and record its object ID in the archived decision.

limitations: Network access to github.com was blocked, so remote state could not be refreshed with `git ls-remote`; remote conclusions use the configured origin-tracking refs and explicit ahead-by-two relationship.
Focused tests could not create temporary files under the managed read-only environment and therefore did not reach collection.
No other reviewers' outputs were read, as required; scientific-role verdicts and their eventual gate effects remain unknown.
The absence of matched secret-like filenames is not a complete content-level secret scan of binary documents or model data.
Remote tag immutability cannot be technically guaranteed by Git hosting alone; only annotated local tag object types and targets were inspected.
recommended_follow_up: Resolve the source/profile hash mismatch and regenerate or supersede affected evidence before another audit run.
Archive portable replay inputs and full outputs or verified content-addressed external storage receipts.
Complete the seven-role audit and validate it on commit 366fc22 or a superseding evidence-only commit whose production tree is proven identical.
With explicit authorization after a passing gate, push the exact reviewed commit, verify the remote object ID, then create and push an annotated release tag.
Record branch, upstream, remote commit, tag object ID, artifact archive locations, and final decision in an append-only release receipt.
